findings.reason: as written the node's only measure cannot be executed, so the worker must invent the reference arm (the last revision that tracked the files, or a materialised overlay) and the gate then proves whatever that constructed reference happened to contain, not the claim the section states.
findings.text: s24's done-when requires that, at a revision "whose runs/ directory is absent", velocity's figures "equal those the same revision gives with the files present", but a commit's tree is fixed, so one revision cannot carry both an absent runs/ directory and the files present, and the population it requires to be "nonzero and equals the ledger's at that revision" is empty by that same premise: velocity reads the ledger at a revision through `_read_ledger`, which returns `{}, None` with the documented consequence that a revision "whose tree carries no ledger reads as a ledger with no runs and reports no digest rather than aborting" (reckon/velocity.py:740-752), so the ledger's count at a revision without the ledger is zero and the equality arm has no reference to compare against

findings.reason: this control decides which marker the worker substitutes for index.json, and the plan names one that would reintroduce the defect being repaired while leaving the post-§26 regression unguarded.
findings.text: s28's positive control, "a repository with a run store and no tracked crew.json is still recognised", names a marker no repository holds and no guard reads: the store resolves to `<config-home>/crew/run_store.db`, shared across projects (reckon/run_store.py:171-182), while both guards and the CLI entry key on repository-local `docs/state/<project>` markers only and say so deliberately — "Reads only repository-local state … unaffected by what else is mounted here" (reckon/hooks/native_agent_guard.py:84-105, reckon/hooks/worker_message_guard.py:47-60, reckon/cli_entry.py:377-388) — so the control is either vacuous or is met by adding host-level state to a repository-local predicate, which is the same class of false positive s28 exists to remove, while the false-negative direction it fences (a crew project carrying neither crew.json nor flight.yaml once §26 removes the ledger) goes untested
